Hugs & Kisses, "X's & O's, is perfect for couples to kick off their shoes and relax their toes. It also sets the tone for a romantic getaway or to celebrate special occasions. This adorable cabin provides a relaxing setting to escape with your significant other, yet is also close enough to restaurants and activities to venture out during your stay. Just minutes away, you can find Mountain Fork Brewery, Okie Girls Ice Cream Shop, Shuck Me, The Tasting Room Bar, and Hochatown Distilling Company. Local attractions like Beavers Bend State Park and Broken Bow Lake are also only a few miles away.

The living room and kitchen area display an open floor plan with a sprawling cathedral ceiling. Snuggle up on the sofa, while relishing the beautiful fireplace flanked by window seats on each side, to enjoy a movie or simply have a conversation. The kitchen is equipped with everything needed to prepare a casual or gourmet meal including a 5-burner gas cooktop. Savor your meal at the bar top or dining room table while sipping your favorite drink.

When walking through the barn door, you transition into a dreamy open suite utopia designed to set a romantic ambiance for two. Lounge and unwind in the oversized soaker tub while enjoying the scents of bath salts by candlelight. The walk-in tile shower for two has a rain shower head and contains a transom window for natural lighting. The cathedral ceilings continue throughout the suite, and the stone wall accents above the dual sinks create a tranquil setting. Several windows throughout the suite allow guests to enjoy the calming effects of natural beauty beyond the walls.

The extensive covered patio is the ideal scenario for those who want to take it easy and enjoy the outdoors. Planning to bring young children or a four- legged friend? Perfect! There is a gate that encloses the entire patio area to ease your mind while outside. The L-shaped couch is situated in front of the stone gas fireplace for a comfy spot to cuddle and enjoy your surroundings. The hot tub is also positioned where you can easily view the fireplace letting your stresses melt away while receiving a jetted massage. Next to the hot tub is a galvanized metal beverage cooler tub with a liner and stand and is easily accessible while in the tub. In the mornings, find your favorite spot to enjoy nature while sipping on a cup of joe. While in the evenings, watch the sunset with a glass of wine at the outdoor bar top table. There is also a fire pit if you prefer to build your own fire to roast marshmallows and star gaze.

X’s and O’s cabin is the place to stay with your loved one to create memories that will last a lifetime.

This cabin is managed by Bear Mountain Management.

Master King Suite:

*King Bed *Soaking Tub *Tile Shower w/ a rain shower head overhead* Smart TV with Roku (guests use their own accounts to stream)
* Linens & Towels (including hot tub towels) *Blow Dryer *Matching bathrobes *Clothes bin
*Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash and lotion provided

Fully Equipped Kitchen:

*Gas Stove *Refrigerator *Gas Oven *Dishwasher *Microwave *Toaster *Blender *Keurig Coffee Maker (dual) *Coffee Bar *Mixer *Cookware *Cookie sheets *Muffin Pan *Measuring Cups & Spoons *Small Crockpot *Cutting Board *Knife Block *Hand Held Can Opener *Drinking Glasses *Coffee Cups *Spice Rack Cooking Utensils *Scissors *Cake Pans *Flatware *Dishes *Granite Countertops *Dining Table w/4 Chairs *Kitchen Bar w/ 2 Bar Stools *Wine Glasses *Rabbit Pro Electric Wine Opener set *Metal Drink Tray

Living Room:

*Couch *Chair *Gas Fireplace *Smart TV with Roku (guests use their own accounts to stream) *DVD Player *Cavalier Portable Bluetooth Wifi Enabled Speaker *Speaker and Soundbar *Remote Control Candles

Outdoors:

*Hot Tub (Drained & sanitized after each stay) *Hot Tub Towel Rack *Gas Grill (Propane is provided for grill) *L-Shaped Couch *Gas Fireplace *Fire Pit *Outdoor Bar Table and 2 Chairs *Small Outdoor Table and 2 Chairs *Pull-down Privacy Screens by the Hot Tub *Galvanized Metal Beverage Cooler Tub *Gated Deck (for pets and young children)

Miscellaneous:

*Central Heat/Air *Washer/Dryer *Free Wifi *Crate for Pets *Queen Blow-up Air Mattress w/ sheets *Additional blankets *First Aid Kit *Fire Extinguisher *Self Check-in/Out *Various DVDs and Books *Checkers/Chess/ Backgammon *Dominoes *Puzzles *Taboo *Scattergories *The Perfect Match *Monopoly

*Starter supply of coffee, sugar, salt, pepper, paper towels, toilet paper, hand soap, dishwashing tabs, trash bags, and laundry soap will be provided.

*NO SMOKING*
*PET FRIENDLY*

03/2025 

My wife and I celebrated our 10-year anniversary here. It was the best time we have had in a long time just getting away and enjoying the peacefulness that this XOXO cabin offered. The place was very clean, and it is in a perfect location at a dead-end circle drive which made it even more off grid and peaceful. We will definitely be coming back again to celebrate an anniversary or just to get away and chill.
~Josh

01/2025 

Absolutely breathtaking!! We came to sight see and spent more time at the cabin than anywhere else. There was great outside seating, soaking hot tub, bath tub, and so much space. Will definitely recommend it to everyone we meet!
~Brantley

12/2024 

X's & O's was in great condition and easy to access. My wife and I really appreciated that there was a Christmas tree up for the holidays. Fireplace both inside and out were easy to use and cozy. The outside patio was perfect with a grill, jacuzzi, comfy couch and fireplace, everything was easy to figure out and use. Our dogs were able to join us! Bed was comfortable! Full kitchen was great as we mostly cooked. Everything you'd want from a cozy cabin in the woods! Oh and the surrounding area and state park was beautiful. We didn't do much but there was definitely plenty to do in the area.
~David

 10/2023

X's and O's Cabin is one of our favorites! So cozy and warm! We appreciate the ability to bring our dog with us as well. Everything you need is provided. Hot tub, great bathtub, amazing shower, fireplaces, smart TV's! It's all there!
~The Fords

04/2023

We had a great stay at the X’s and O’s Cabin and loved getting to bring our dogs with us instead of having to board them! It had everything we needed, was close to all of the places we wanted to visit, and the bed was super comfy!  I would definitely recommend it to my friends and family as a great place to stay!
~Carrie B.

CHECK-IN: Check-in begins at 4:00 pm. If you plan to arrive after 4:00 pm, please email us at bearmountainlodging@gmail.com. This will help us better prioritize our cleaning schedule during the busy times of year. Honey Bear is a self check-in cabin, and you will receive your directions via email 7 days before your arrival.

CHECK-OUT: Check-out is at 11:00 am. To make departure day more efficient for everyone, please text 580-212-4746 if you decide to depart early. This will help us with getting the next guest in on time. Owner is not responsible for items left in the cabin. If requested, items will be shipped for a $25.00 handling fee plus actual shipping costs.
Renter agrees to maintain cleanliness of the cabin during their stay and leave the cabin in a reasonably clean condition when they depart. All dirty dishes should be placed in the dishwasher and turned on before leaving the cabin. Refrigerator needs to be emptied of all food. Tie up trash bags and place them in outside containers. Please start a load of towels before your departure. Please do not strip the beds, the cleaning staff will take care of that. We will take care of the rest! Excessive cleaning fees could apply if policy is not followed.

DOWN PAYMENT: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover. You will need to use one of the major credit cards to make a reservation. The down payment (Reservation Fee) is 20% of the cost of the total reservation. Down payments are applied toward the balance. The down payment (Reservation Fee) is nonrefundable.

FINAL PAYMENT: The balance is due 30 days prior to your arrival.

AGE REQUIREMENT: You must be 25 years of age to reserve this vacation rental. This cabin is limited to families or adults 25 years of age or older. For couples (2 Adults) the age limit is 21 years of age. We reserve the right to refuse service with monies forfeited if any discrepancies in our policies are suspected.

MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY-4 people: Do not exceed the maximum occupancy allowed for the cabin. Guests that violate this restriction will be asked to leave and will lose all rental fees. We do require a list of names and ages of guests before your arrival if you did not provide it at the time of your reservation.

RESERVATION REQUIREMENT: There is a 2 night minimum required. There is a 3 or 4 night minimum for holidays and high peak season.

CHANGING CABINS OR DATES: Date changes or removing nights are subject to a $50 fee. You cannot make a change if you are within 30 days of your arrival date. Reservations cannot be moved from one cabin to another.

NO HOUSE PARTIES OR EVENTS: House parties or events are strictly prohibited. Rental guests understand that we will accept families, married couples, and responsible adults 21 years of age and older ONLY. Renters acknowledge that violation of this agreement will lead to your being required to leave with NO refund. Guests must state, in advance, the number of renters/guests during their stay at Honey Bear.

ATV RIDING IS PROHIBITED ON THE PREMISES: It is illegal to ride ATVs on the area roads also if you are not properly tagged.

PETS ARE ALLOWED: This cabin is pet friendly and allows up to 2 dogs that are 40 pounds or less each with a $75.00 NON-REFUNDABLE FEE per pet. You will be required to provide the name of your pet, the breed, age, and weight.

NO DAILY HOUSEKEEPING SERVICE IS PROVIDED.

NO SMOKING IN CABIN: We ask that you do not smoke inside the cabin. Ashtrays will be provided outside. Please put your cigarette butts in the ashtrays. Non-compliance will result in a $100 per day charge.

SHOOTING GUNS OR FIREWORKS is prohibited on cabin property.

HOT TUBS & COVERS: Our hot tubs are cleaned and chemically treated after every rental. Hot tub use is strictly at your own risk. Persons with high blood pressure, skin sensitivities, or who might be pregnant are strongly urged not to use a hot tub.
PLEASE do not allow anyone in your group to walk-on, jump-on or play-on the hot tub covers, they will break. The condition of the hot tub is checked after every checkout and before your arrival.

WE LOVE OUR TREES! Please do not cut on or cut down trees on the property. Fines will be charged to your account for damaging trees.

PROPERTY ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT: Please do not tamper with the electronics, television, receivers, etc. equipment in the cabin. Also please do not unhook or disconnect any cords or wires from any of the equipment. We do check the TV’s, DirecTv receivers, and surround sound to ensure they are in working order. Please make sure everything is in working order before you leave. A $100 fee will be charged for unhooking or tampering with any electronic device.

OUTDOOR SURVEILLANCE: There is a device on the front porch facing the driveway, another affixed to the back of the cabin facing the back stairs, and devices on each side of the cabin facing outward.

MAINTENANCE PROBLEMS will be addressed in as timely a manner as possible. However the rental rate cannot be adjusted due to any malfunction of equipment (which includes T.V., VCR, DVD, heating units, hot water heaters, stoves, refrigerators, hot tubs, locks etc). In the extremely rare case where there is a major problem with heat, hot water, etc that makes the home uninhabitable we will try to arrange a different accommodation. If that is not possible, all fees will be refunded.

COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide. All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation, therefore NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS.
LIABILITY NOTICE: Acknowledging this contract signifies you, as the guests, agree to all above policies and certifies you as the guest are 21 years of age or older. This cabin is privately owned, the homeowners or property management are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. The Homeowner or property management are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises or others whom they invite to use the premises.
If anyone neglects to follow the rules, policies, and suggestions of Bear Mountain Lodging, LLC the guests cannot hold us responsible for their actions, accidents, or neglect. Once your first payment is received, it is considered a rental agreement and is considered a legal and binding contract.

Because this agreement specifically prohibits keeping pets without the permission of Bear Mountain Management, Guests agree to the following terms and conditions in exchange for their permission: 

  1. Guests will pay an additional pet fee in the amount of $75 per stay, per pet.
  2. All Pets must comply with the following:
    1. May not exceed 40 lbs.
    2. Must be at least 1 year of age or older.
    3. Must be up-to-date on rabies vaccinations and all other vaccinations
  3. No more than two pets are allowed on the property.
  4. Pets are NOT allowed on furniture, mainly the bed, at any time. Any evidence of pets on furniture may incur extra cleaning fees.
  5. Guests agree to clean up after their pet and to dispose of their pet's waste properly and quickly. Any evidence of pet’s waste on the property may incur extra cleaning fees.
  6. Guests agree not to leave their pet unattended at the property. If the pet is unattended for short amounts of time, the pet will be crated either with the one provided or one brought from home. 
  7. Pets must not cause damage to premises or furnishings. If damages are caused, the cost of the damage may be charged to guests.
  8. Guests agree to keep their pets under control at all times.
  9. Guests agree to keep their pet restrained, but not tethered, when it is outside their dwelling.
  10. Guests agree to adhere to local ordinances, including leash and licensing requirements.
  11. Guests agree not to leave food or water for their pet or any other animal outside their dwelling where it may attract other animals.
  12. Guests agree to keep their pet from being unnecessarily noisy or aggressive and causing any annoyance or discomfort to others and will remedy immediately if any complaints are made through Bear Mountain Management.
  13. Guests agree that this Agreement applies only to the specific pet/s described above and that no other pet may be substituted.
  14. Homeowner/ Bear Mountain Management assumes no responsibility for illness or injury that may occur to pets or humans while on the premises.
  15. Guests agree that Bear Mountain Management reserves the right to revoke permission to keep the pet should the Renters break these agreements to keep their pet restrained, but not tethered, when it is outside their dwelling. 

The guest shall be solely responsible for the pet while on the property.

CANCELLATION POLICY
*Regardless of notice a cancellation will result in the loss of your Reservation Fee.
*We require a 30-day notice of cancellation. You will forfeit your full amount if the cancellation is made 30 days or less prior to your arrival date.
*We request all cancellations in writing, via email. We will accept cancellations via phone, but will again request a follow up email. Only the guest on the reservation may cancel a reservation.
*Inclement weather does not make a valid cancellation.
*If the cabin can be rebooked, we will refund you less the Reservation Fee.
*Trip Insurance can be purchased at www.insuremytrip.com.
COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide. All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation, therefore NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS.

The extensive covered patio is the ideal scenario for those who want to take it easy and enjoy the outdoors. Planning to bring young children or a four- legged friend? Perfect! There is a gate that encloses the entire patio area to ease your mind while outside. The L-shaped couch is situated in front of the stone gas fireplace for a comfy spot to cuddle and enjoy your surroundings. The hot tub is also positioned where you can easily view the fireplace letting your stresses melt away while receiving a jetted massage. Next to the hot tub is a galvanized metal beverage cooler tub with a liner and stand and is easily accessible while in the tub. In the mornings, find your favorite spot to enjoy nature while sipping on a cup of joe. While in the evenings, watch the sunset with a glass of wine at the outdoor bar top table. There is also a fire pit if you prefer to build your own fire to roast marshmallows and star gaze.

X’s and O’s cabin is the place to stay with your loved one to create memories that will last a lifetime.

This cabin is managed by Bear Mountain Management.

Master King Suite:

*King Bed *Soaking Tub *Tile Shower w/ a rain shower head overhead* Smart TV with Roku (guests use their own accounts to stream)
* Linens & Towels (including hot tub towels) *Blow Dryer *Matching bathrobes *Clothes bin

Living Room:

Outdoors:

CHECK-IN: Check-in begins at 4:00 pm. If you plan to arrive after 4:00 pm, please email us at bearmountainlodging@gmail.com. This will help us better prioritize our cleaning schedule during the busy times of year. Honey Bear is a self check-in cabin, and you will receive your directions via email 7 days before your arrival.

CHECK-OUT: Check-out is at 11:00 am. To make departure day more efficient for everyone, please text 580-212-4746 if you decide to depart early. This will help us with getting the next guest in on time. Owner is not responsible for items left in the cabin. If requested, items will be shipped for a $25.00 handling fee plus actual shipping costs.
Renter agrees to maintain cleanliness of the cabin during their stay and leave the cabin in a reasonably clean condition when they depart. All dirty dishes should be placed in the dishwasher and turned on before leaving the cabin. Refrigerator needs to be emptied of all food. Tie up trash bags and place them in outside containers. Please start a load of towels before your departure. Please do not strip the beds, the cleaning staff will take care of that. We will take care of the rest! Excessive cleaning fees could apply if policy is not followed.

DOWN PAYMENT: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover. You will need to use one of the major credit cards to make a reservation. The down payment (Reservation Fee) is 20% of the cost of the total reservation. Down payments are applied toward the balance. The down payment (Reservation Fee) is nonrefundable.

FINAL PAYMENT: The balance is due 30 days prior to your arrival.

AGE REQUIREMENT: You must be 25 years of age to reserve this vacation rental. This cabin is limited to families or adults 25 years of age or older. For couples (2 Adults) the age limit is 21 years of age. We reserve the right to refuse service with monies forfeited if any discrepancies in our policies are suspected.

MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY-4 people: Do not exceed the maximum occupancy allowed for the cabin. Guests that violate this restriction will be asked to leave and will lose all rental fees. We do require a list of names and ages of guests before your arrival if you did not provide it at the time of your reservation.

RESERVATION REQUIREMENT: There is a 2 night minimum required. There is a 3 or 4 night minimum for holidays and high peak season.

CHANGING CABINS OR DATES: Date changes or removing nights are subject to a $50 fee. You cannot make a change if you are within 30 days of your arrival date. Reservations cannot be moved from one cabin to another.

NO HOUSE PARTIES OR EVENTS: House parties or events are strictly prohibited. Rental guests understand that we will accept families, married couples, and responsible adults 21 years of age and older ONLY. Renters acknowledge that violation of this agreement will lead to your being required to leave with NO refund. Guests must state, in advance, the number of renters/guests during their stay at Honey Bear.

ATV RIDING IS PROHIBITED ON THE PREMISES: It is illegal to ride ATVs on the area roads also if you are not properly tagged.

PETS ARE ALLOWED: This cabin is pet friendly and allows up to 2 dogs that are 40 pounds or less each with a $75.00 NON-REFUNDABLE FEE per pet. You will be required to provide the name of your pet, the breed, age, and weight.

NO DAILY HOUSEKEEPING SERVICE IS PROVIDED.

NO SMOKING IN CABIN: We ask that you do not smoke inside the cabin. Ashtrays will be provided outside. Please put your cigarette butts in the ashtrays. Non-compliance will result in a $100 per day charge.

SHOOTING GUNS OR FIREWORKS is prohibited on cabin property.

HOT TUBS & COVERS: Our hot tubs are cleaned and chemically treated after every rental. Hot tub use is strictly at your own risk. Persons with high blood pressure, skin sensitivities, or who might be pregnant are strongly urged not to use a hot tub.
PLEASE do not allow anyone in your group to walk-on, jump-on or play-on the hot tub covers, they will break. The condition of the hot tub is checked after every checkout and before your arrival.

WE LOVE OUR TREES! Please do not cut on or cut down trees on the property. Fines will be charged to your account for damaging trees.

PROPERTY ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT: Please do not tamper with the electronics, television, receivers, etc. equipment in the cabin. Also please do not unhook or disconnect any cords or wires from any of the equipment. We do check the TV’s, DirecTv receivers, and surround sound to ensure they are in working order. Please make sure everything is in working order before you leave. A $100 fee will be charged for unhooking or tampering with any electronic device.

OUTDOOR SURVEILLANCE: There is a device on the front porch facing the driveway, another affixed to the back of the cabin facing the back stairs, and devices on each side of the cabin facing outward.

MAINTENANCE PROBLEMS will be addressed in as timely a manner as possible. However the rental rate cannot be adjusted due to any malfunction of equipment (which includes T.V., VCR, DVD, heating units, hot water heaters, stoves, refrigerators, hot tubs, locks etc). In the extremely rare case where there is a major problem with heat, hot water, etc that makes the home uninhabitable we will try to arrange a different accommodation. If that is not possible, all fees will be refunded.

COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide. All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation, therefore NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS.
LIABILITY NOTICE: Acknowledging this contract signifies you, as the guests, agree to all above policies and certifies you as the guest are 21 years of age or older. This cabin is privately owned, the homeowners or property management are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. The Homeowner or property management are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises or others whom they invite to use the premises.
If anyone neglects to follow the rules, policies, and suggestions of Bear Mountain Lodging, LLC the guests cannot hold us responsible for their actions, accidents, or neglect. Once your first payment is received, it is considered a rental agreement and is considered a legal and binding contract.

Because this agreement specifically prohibits keeping pets without the permission of Bear Mountain Management, Guests agree to the following terms and conditions in exchange for their permission: 

  1. Guests will pay an additional pet fee in the amount of $75 per stay, per pet.
  2. All Pets must comply with the following:
    1. May not exceed 40 lbs.
    2. Must be at least 1 year of age or older.
    3. Must be up-to-date on rabies vaccinations and all other vaccinations
  3. No more than two pets are allowed on the property.
  4. Pets are NOT allowed on furniture, mainly the bed, at any time. Any evidence of pets on furniture may incur extra cleaning fees.
  5. Guests agree to clean up after their pet and to dispose of their pet's waste properly and quickly. Any evidence of pet’s waste on the property may incur extra cleaning fees.
  6. Guests agree not to leave their pet unattended at the property. If the pet is unattended for short amounts of time, the pet will be crated either with the one provided or one brought from home. 
  7. Pets must not cause damage to premises or furnishings. If damages are caused, the cost of the damage may be charged to guests.
  8. Guests agree to keep their pets under control at all times.
  9. Guests agree to keep their pet restrained, but not tethered, when it is outside their dwelling.
  10. Guests agree to adhere to local ordinances, including leash and licensing requirements.
  11. Guests agree not to leave food or water for their pet or any other animal outside their dwelling where it may attract other animals.
  12. Guests agree to keep their pet from being unnecessarily noisy or aggressive and causing any annoyance or discomfort to others and will remedy immediately if any complaints are made through Bear Mountain Management.
  13. Guests agree that this Agreement applies only to the specific pet/s described above and that no other pet may be substituted.
  14. Homeowner/ Bear Mountain Management assumes no responsibility for illness or injury that may occur to pets or humans while on the premises.
  15. Guests agree that Bear Mountain Management reserves the right to revoke permission to keep the pet should the Renters break these agreements to keep their pet restrained, but not tethered, when it is outside their dwelling. 

The guest shall be solely responsible for the pet while on the property.

CANCELLATION POLICY
*Regardless of notice a cancellation will result in the loss of your Reservation Fee.
*We require a 30-day notice of cancellation. You will forfeit your full amount if the cancellation is made 30 days or less prior to your arrival date.
*We request all cancellations in writing, via email. We will accept cancellations via phone, but will again request a follow up email. Only the guest on the reservation may cancel a reservation.
*Inclement weather does not make a valid cancellation.
*If the cabin can be rebooked, we will refund you less the Reservation Fee.
*Trip Insurance can be purchased at www.insuremytrip.com.
COVID 19: As of March 14, 2020, the Covid-19 pandemic has been widely publicized worldwide. All guests who book reservations are now aware of the risk and therefore our full cancellation policy is in effect. Covid 19 is not a valid reason for cancellation, therefore NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS.
